newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan quake kills 10, new tremor injures three.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan quake kills 10, new tremor injures three.

text.p: At least 10 people were killed by an overnight earthquake in a northwestern Pakistani border region, state radio said on Thursday as a fresh tremor injured several people in the southwest.

Apart from the deaths several people were injured when houses collapsed during Wednesday night's quake in the northwestern Bajaur area, near the Afghan border, the radio said. No further details were available.

A moderate tremor on Thursday, meanwhile, rocked southwestern province of Baluchistan, bringing down at least eight mud-and-stone houses in the mountainous Harnai area and injuring at least three people, officials said.

A government seismic centre said Wednesday night's quake, measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale, powerful enough to cause heavy damage in a populated area, had shaken the provincial capital Quetta and nearby areas, where a more powerful tremor on February 28 killed about 50 people.
However, a Finnish seismology centre said it had read the quake's intensity at 6.0 on the Richter scale.
The epicentre was located in the Koh-i-Suleman mountain range, north of Quetta, near the Afghan border, an official of the Pakistani seismic centre in the town of Peshawar said.
The February 28 quake, measuring 6.2 on the Richter scale, was also centred in the Koh-i-Suleman range.
